item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 07/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of southern China this morning. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, it will be mainly fine with cool mornings over southern China midweek this week. A warm maritime airstream is expected to bring humid and foggy weather to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week to early next week.

Date/Month: 07/03 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, becoming north force 4 to 5 in the morning.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. A few rain patches and relatively low visibility in some areas in the morning. Cool in the morning and at night. Becoming fine and dry in the afternoon.
Temp range: 16 - 22 C
R.H. range: 55 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
